from itertools import permutations
demos=[(di,do),(d2i,d2o)]
def blocks7():
    out=[]
    for p in set(permutations((3,2,2))):
        b=[];s=0
        for x in p: b.append(list(range(s,s+x))); s+=x
        out.append(b)
    return out
def mkprops():
    P={}
    def add(name,f): P[name]=f
    add('maj_filler', lambda c,bg,fl: c.count(fl)>c.count(bg))
    add('parity_filler', lambda c,bg,fl: c.count(fl)%2==1)
    add('parity_bg', lambda c,bg,fl: c.count(bg)%2==1)
    add('special_odd', lambda c,bg,fl: sum(1 for x in c if x not in (bg,fl))%2==1)
    add('special_even_nonzero', lambda c,bg,fl: sum(1 for x in c if x not in (bg,fl))%2==0 and any(x not in (bg,fl) for x in c))
    add('any_special', lambda c,bg,fl: any(x not in (bg,fl) for x in c))
    add('no_special', lambda c,bg,fl: not any(x not in (bg,fl) for x in c))
    add('no_filler', lambda c,bg,fl: fl not in c)
    add('no_anything', lambda c,bg,fl: all(x==bg for x in c))
    add('distinct_ge2', lambda c,bg,fl: len(set(c))>=2)
    add('distinct_ge3', lambda c,bg,fl: len(set(c))>=3)
    return P
props=mkprops()
res=[]
for rps in blocks7():
    for cps in blocks7():
        for name,f in props.items():
            ok=True
            for inp,out in demos:
                bg=max(set(x for r in inp for x in r), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in inp))
                cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
                fl=max((v for v in cnt if v!=bg), key=lambda v: cnt[v])
                tgt={(i,j) for i in range(3) for j in range(3) if out[i][j]==8}
                s={(i,j) for i,B in enumerate(rps) for j,C in enumerate(cps)
                   if f([inp[a][b] for a in B for b in C],bg,fl)}
                if s!=tgt: ok=False;break
            if ok: res.append(([ [r[0],r[-1]] for r in rps],[c[0] for c in cps],name))
print(res)

demos=[(di,do),(d2i,d2o),(d3i,d3o)]
from collections import Counter
for inp,out in demos:
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fl=max((v for v in cnt if v!=bg), key=lambda v: cnt[v])
    sp=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,fl)]
    print('bg',bg,'fl',fl,'sp',sp, dict(cnt))
    # per residue: counts of bg, fl, specials; distinct specials
    print(' res: bg fl sp distinctSp')
    for i in range(3):
        row=[]
        for j in range(3):
            cells=[inp[a][b] for a in range(7) for b in range(7) if a%3==i and b%3==j]
            c=Counter(cells)
            nsp=sum(v for k,v in c.items() if k not in (bg,fl))
            row.append((c[bg],c[fl],nsp,len([k for k in c if k not in (bg,fl)])))
        print(' ',i,row)
    print(' out',out)

G=load(); print(sorted(G))
d3i,d3o=G['Demo pair 3 input'],G['Demo pair 3 output']
demos=[(di,do),(d2i,d2o),(d3i,d3o)]
from collections import Counter
for inp,out in demos:
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fl=max((v for v in cnt if v!=bg), key=lambda v: cnt[v])
    sp=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,fl)]
    print('bg',bg,'fl',fl,'sp',sorted(sp), dict(sorted(cnt.items())))
    print(' res(bg,fl,nsp,ndistinct):')
    for i in range(3):
        row=[]
        for j in range(3):
            cells=[inp[a][b] for a in range(7) for b in range(7) if a%3==i and b%3==j]
            c=Counter(cells)
            nsp=sum(v for k,v in c.items() if k not in (bg,fl))
            row.append((c[bg],c[fl],nsp,len([k for k in c if k not in (bg,fl)])))
        print(' ',i,row)
    print(' out',out)
